title: MVFA: A Multi-View Text-Guided Multimodal Fusion LLM Adapter for Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.06188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis and emotion recognition in conversations demand effective modeling of heterogeneous interactions across textual, acoustic, and visual modalities. Although large language models (LLMs) offer powerful language understanding, adapting them to multimodal affective computing remains challenging: full-model fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive, while many existing lightweight adapters fail to preserve rich textual cues during cross-modal fusion. To address these limitations, we propose the multi-view text-guided multimodal fusion adapter (MVFA), a parameter-efficient framework that augments frozen LLMs with strong multimodal reasoning capability. MVFA first constructs complementary text views via max pooling, mean pooling, and attention pooling; these views then guide cross-modal interactions with audio and visual features. translated_title: MVFA：一种用于情感分析与情绪识别的多视图文本引导多模态融合大语言模型适配器
translated_abstract: 多模态情感分析和对话中的情绪识别需要对文本、声学和视觉模态之间的异构交互进行有效建模。尽管大语言模型（LLM）具备强大的语言理解能力，但将其适配到多模态情感计算仍然充满挑战：全模型微调的计算成本令人望而却步，而许多现有的轻量级适配器在跨模态融合过程中无法保留丰富的文本线索。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了多视图文本引导多模态融合适配器（MVFA），这是一个参数高效的框架，能够为冻结的大语言模型赋予强大的多模态推理能力。MVFA首先通过最大池化、平均池化和注意力池化构建互补的文本视图，随后利用这些视图引导与音频和视觉特征之间的跨模态交互。融合后的多模态表示随后被压缩成一组紧凑的（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MVFA，一种参数高效的多视图文本引导多模态融合适配器，通过最大池化、平均池化和注意力池化构建互补文本视图以引导跨模态融合，以低成本增强冻结的大语言模型在多模态情感分析与情绪识别任务中的能力。
